mapping.sheet: Tie sheet default1.6, adjustable1.6–2mm. Rail face redesigned2–2.6mm.
mapping.interfaces: 4.5mm-wide tongues, length equal rail thickness, into four (4.5+fit) by (sheet+fit) sockets. 12mm shoulders define the fabric gap.
mapping.allowance: Proposed .15mm TOTAL default,.1–.3. Not the measured .100012 gap; calibration and adhesive required.
mapping.tabs: 16 bed-flat Boolean-unioned runners,.8–1.4wide,.4–.6thick; thicker than measured source .21/.22. Snip1.6mm beyond edges; no attachment to tongues.

originalDesign.interaction: Two upright parallel pierced rails support gentle alternate-side cord lacing of reinforced fabric edges; low horizontal ties set a fixed span. Not a repeat of a knitting loom or braiding guide; fabric remains a sheet.
originalDesign.assembly: Slide both ties into one rail, slide opposite rail onto both free tongues, bond four fixed seats, lace reinforced cloth. No trapped joints, snapping or elastic insertion.
originalDesign.artKeepout: 13mm diameter patch at workingRail/2+7,railHeight/2 on broad rail face; at least1.4mm backing; remote from sockets and lacing eyes.
